prerequisites: passed Theoretical Knowledge Examination for Private Pilot Licence

learning_outcomes.text: Students apply interdisciplinary knowledge within this module and deepen their knowledge significantly through practice-relevant tasks from aircraft maintenance, development (especially cockpit development) and flight testing through practical ground and flight tests.
Students possess the knowledge to evaluate, describe, and discuss the behavior of aircraft, and to determine the flight characteristics of aircraft.
Through practical exercises with interdisciplinary content, students gain the competence to analyze, evaluate, and critically reflect on relevant content and (test) results in the field of avionics.
Execution of practical ground and flight tests, simulated aircraft maintenance events, or development tasks (especially in cockpit development).
Students can select suitable components for carrying out avionics-relevant tasks.
They can apply common working methods, record and present measured values.
Students can evaluate test results and present them in a measurement report that ensures the reproducibility of the measurement.
Students have an increased interdisciplinary competence for describing and analyzing avionics-relevant tasks, supported by experiments/examples.

syllabus_topics: Technology used in conjunction with computers
Introduction to AI and Cyber Security
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance is a written examination. The duration and scope of the examination are specified in the currently valid study regulations.
